pages.lesson:
LESSON: ENERGY: HEAT AND ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment
Topic 1.6: Energy: Heat and its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Energy: Heat and its resources. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify sources of heat in the sources of heat in the environment environment (sun, gas cooker, 1.6.1 Sources of Heat
2. match different sources of heat to electric cooker, charcoal burner, their fuels in the environment traditional jiko, stove)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify sources of heat in the sources of heat in the environment environment (sun, gas cooker, 1.6.1 Sources of Heat
   In simple words: practise until you can identify sources of heat in the sources of heat in the environment environment (sun, gas cooker, 1.6.1 Sources of Heat. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. match different sources of heat to electric cooker, charcoal burner, their fuels in the environment traditional jiko, stove)
   In simple words: practise until you can match different sources of heat to electric cooker, charcoal burner, their fuels in the environment traditional jiko, stove). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Energy: Heat and its resources using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Energy: Heat and its resources in the examples.
2. Explain Energy: Heat and its resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Energy: Heat and its resources.
4. Show that you can: identify sources of heat in the sources of heat in the environment environment (sun, gas cooker, 1.6.1 Sources of Heat

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Energy: Heat and its resources using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Energy: Heat and its resources important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Think, pair and share heat in the community. their experiences on sources of heat at home and community
2. In groups, learners to match the different sources of heat with the fuels used (gas, electricity, charcoal, firewood, kerosene)
3. Learners interact with parents or guardians to appreciate the types of fuels used in the community and report back.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify sources of heat in the sources of heat in the environment environment (sun, gas cooker, 1.6.1 Sources of Heat
2. match different sources of heat to electric cooker, charcoal burner, their fuels in the environment traditional jiko, stove)
